capabilities: Sync saved contacts and work colleagues from Microsoft 365
Import contacts from CSV or vCard files
Create a minimal person note on first mention
Match nicknames and aliases to people
extras: Microsoft 365 access is read-only and needs your own Entra app registration; the session is kept in Obsidian's secret storage outside the vault. CSV/vCard import works without signing in, and re-importing updates contacts by email instead of duplicating them.
problem: Obsidian's link suggestions only know notes that already exist, so mentioning a new person means creating their note and typing the full name by hand.

relations.evidence: The plugin signs in to Microsoft the same way as the Outlook Calendar Panel and Microsoft To Do Panel plugins
The plugin signs in to Microsoft the same way as the Outlook Calendar Panel and Microsoft To Do Panel plugins
It syncs your Outlook contacts and the people you work with

summary: Syncs Microsoft 365 contacts or imports CSV/vCard files, then autocompletes people as links and creates a minimal person note on first mention.
